summary: Batch IMS database UNLOAD program for the pending-authorization database. Sequentially walks the IMS pending-authorization database (summary root segments and their detail children) and writes each segment to a sequential output file, reporting the number of segments unloaded. The counterpart of PAUDBLOD.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Open the output file. Walk the IMS pending-auth database: get the next summary root segment; for each, get its detail children; write each summary and detail to the output file. Continue until the database is exhausted, then report the counts and return.

annotations.note: IMS unload: root (summary) and child (detail) segments are written to a sequential file (reload via PAUDBLOD).

paragraphs.name: 1000-INITIALIZE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Open the output file and initialize counters.

paragraphs.name: 2000-GET-NEXT-SUMMARY
paragraphs.pseudocode: Get (GN) the next pending-auth summary root segment; set end-of-db when exhausted.

paragraphs.name: 3000-GET-NEXT-DETAIL
paragraphs.pseudocode: Get (GNP) the next detail child under the current summary; set no-more-details when exhausted.

paragraphs.name: 4000-WRITE-OUTPUT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Write the current segment (summary or detail) to the sequential output file and count it.

paragraphs.name: 9000-FINALIZE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Close the output file and display the counts of segments unloaded.
